long_biography.plain_text:
Commendatore entered the mattress company run by his father, Francesco, bringing research, marketing and a direct television presence to the family business. Eminflex's early local television sales grew into national campaigns, while the company says cumulative mattress sales later exceeded 20 million. The family holding acquired Permaflex in 1998. Under its management, Permaflex says revenue rose sevenfold in one year and fiftyfold within four years.

Automobiles became a second entrepreneurial thread. Commendatore spent years around Emilia's supercar industry before founding Giamaro Automobili in Modena in 2021 with his son Pierfrancesco. Giamaro's debut programme centred on the Krafla and Albor, both powered by a purpose-built quad-turbo V12.
